review_result.summary: The code is well-structured and readable, but there are some issues with performance, security, and best practices.

issues.description: The HTML file does not have a DOCTYPE declaration for HTML5.

issues.description: The script tag is not using the 'defer' attribute, which can cause the script to block the parsing of the HTML document.

issues.description: The JavaScript code is not using a consistent naming convention.

issues.description: The game is using the 'requestAnimationFrame' function to update the game state, but it is not using a consistent frame rate.

issues.description: The game is using the 'addEventListener' function to handle user input, but it is not removing the event listeners when the game is over.
issues.suggestion: Remove the event listeners when the game is over to prevent memory leaks and security vulnerabilities.
